:::{#def-loocv}
#### Leave-one-out cross-validation

**Leave-one-out cross-validation (LOOCV)**
is [$k$-fold cross-validation](#def-kfold) with $k = n$,
so that each of the $n$ [folds](#def-folds) holds one observation,
and the [fold-out rule](#def-fold-out-rule) $\fittedwo{\foldof{i}}{\cdot}$
of observation $i$'s [fold](#def-fold-assignment)
is fitted to all observations except observation $i$.
Its [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate) (@eq-cv-estimate with $k = n$) is

$$
\cvest{n} = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i \in I} \sqf{\fittedwo{\foldof{i}}{x_i} - y_i}.
$$ {#eq-loocv}
